about: Apps that wait for connections from other devices. Used by The Shunt for 'let devices in the tunnel reach this app'. Add an app with a pull request: name, ports (tcp/PORT, udp/PORT or tcp/FIRST-LAST, at most 64 per range), a short note. Only ports the app really listens on; no personal data.

apps.name: Syncthing
apps.note: File sync. Discovery in the local network (udp/21027) does not go through a tunnel.

apps.name: Termux SSH
apps.note: sshd of Termux. Use keys, not passwords.

apps.name: Sunshine
apps.note: Game stream host. Moonlight, the client, needs nothing here.
